findings.title: Wait for the reader thread before asserting
findings.body: The test sets `deletedAll` and checks `caughtExceptions` without joining the reader thread or synchronizing its start. It can therefore pass without any overlapping read, or assert before an in-flight read records an exception; the reader can also outlive the test. A deletion failure before `deletedAll.set(true)` can leave its non-daemon loop running indefinitely. Coordinate the reader's start and completion, and stop it in a `finally` block.
